build_vocab_and_binarize: build vocabularies and binarize training data for machine translation using fairseq preprocess CLI
run_preprocess_cli: run the fairseq preprocess CLI to binarize source and target language training data
build_dictionary: build a dictionary from training data files with configurable threshold and word count limits
binarize_dataset: binarize text data into indexed dataset format using multiprocessing for faster processing
binarize_alignments: binarize alignment data files into indexed dataset format for training alignment models
